## Derived columns (computed in reduce_raw.py)

| column | derivation |
|---|---|
| `month`, `dow` | from properly parsed DISCOVERY_DATE (the 2020 bug made these constants) |
| `doy_std` | leap-safe: post-Feb-28 days shift down 1 in leap years so Mar 1 is always 60 |
| `burn_days` | CONT_DATE - DISCOVERY_DATE in days; nulled when negative or > 400 days (audited in data_audit.json) |
| `cause_group` | NWCG general cause -> 7 ML buckets; NaN when NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE is the missing/undetermined label |
| `old13` | APPROXIMATE crosswalk to the retired 13-class taxonomy; museum replica only |
